meta.title: Divergent Neural Cloud: Persicaria – Shining Edge

units.rawText: Divergent Program installation complete... Persicaria, how do you feel?

spans.text: Divergent Program installation complete... Persicaria, how do you feel?

units.rawText: It's just like back then... I feel very good. Though, there are a few instabilities when reallocating operands. I should be able to deal with that after adapting to it.
